name: Nora to Oujo to Noraneko Heart 2
original_name: ノラと皇女と野良猫ハート2
source:
This is the sequel for Noratoto, featuring new heroines Iris and Noel. Subheroine Nobuchina, Lucia and Eurasia get their own routes, while of course there are after stories for the main heroines of the previous game. The game takes place during the summer at the beach where Nora worked. Snow began to fall one day, signaling the Snow Queen Iris’ impending appearance.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/10/17/october-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《诺拉托》的续集，由新女主角艾丽丝和诺埃尔主演。女主角信支那、露西亚和欧亚大陆都有自己的路线，当然还有前作女主角的后续故事。游戏发生在诺拉工作的夏天的海​​滩上。有一天，雪开始飘落，预示着冰雪女王艾丽丝即将出现。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/10/17/october-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
